defects.claim_says: Executive Order 12220, in its own section on the Department of Agriculture, directs the Secretary of Agriculture, after the same consultation, to transmit to the Congress all reports required by section 408 of the Act
defects.source_says: EO 12220 section 1-103 (45 FR 44245) requires consultation with the Secretary of State, the Secretary of the Treasury, the Director of the United States International Development Cooperation Agency, the Chairman of the Council of Economic Advisers, the Director of the Office of Management and Budget and the Assistant to the President for National Security Affairs. EO 11963 section 1 (42 FR 4325) instead names the Administrator of the Agency for International Development and also the Chairman of the Council on International Economic Policy. The consultation list differs, so 'after the same consultation' misstates the source.

reasoning: With the dates corrected to 1980-06-27 the ending is right: EO 12220 of June 27, 1980, section 1-501, revoked EO 10900 as amended, which carries both amendments made by EO 11963 under the strike-and-insert ruling; the date matches the FR text, the source's signing date, the OFR 'Revoked by: EO 12220, June 27, 1980' note and the claim's reasons; EO 12148 and EO 12163 touch other sections of EO 10900, so no earlier end appears; the whole-order end equals the latest clause end. Every hash and quoted span checks. The claim is still rejected under the same standard applied in the blind review, because its savings reason says EO 12220 reissues the reporting direction 'after the same consultation' when the officials EO 12220 names differ from those EO 11963 names (IDCA Director in place of the AID Administrator; no Chairman of the Council on International Economic Policy). The fix is a wording change ('after consultation with a revised list of officials'); it does not affect the end date or status.
